description: This file contains unit tests for the DynamoDB-based Orleans Membership Table, verifying its operations such as get gateways, read/write rows, update, and cleanup, specifically for AWS DynamoDB integration.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipTableTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DynamoDB Membership Table operations in Orleans, testing AWS DynamoDB integration.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filters for tracing DynamoDB and storage operations.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of DynamoDBMembershipTable if DynamoDB is available, otherwise throws a skip exception.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates a DynamoDBGatewayListProvider for gateway discovery.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Returns the connection string for DynamoDB service if available.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_GetGateways
methods.description: Test for retrieving gateway list from DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test for reading all entries from an empty DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_InsertRow
methods.description: Test for inserting a row into DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test for reading a row after inserting it into DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test for reading all entries after inserting multiple entries into DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_UpdateRow
methods.description: Test for updating a row in DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test for cleaning up defunct silo entries in DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test for updating rows in parallel in DynamoDB membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_DynamoDB_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test for updating the 'I am alive' status in DynamoDB membership table.
